capabilityIntents.conditions: Only explicitly linked, schema-marked Markdown inside the canonical vault boundary.
Relationship context is evidence only when stable party references are explicitly declared.

scopeVerification.boundary: The caller binds the user and workspace while the adapter confines reads to the canonical vault root and explicit linked notes.

dataSemantics.missingness: Missing, denied, failed, filtered, truncated and unsupported are distinct; none may be interpreted as zero or absence.

pagination.cursorBehavior: Each read performs a bounded walk; no durable cross-run cursor is claimed.

connection.credentialBoundary: Canonical local path confinement replaces a remote credential boundary.

actionSafety.uncertainOutcomeBehavior: Stop and require verification plus human resolution before retry.
